name: San Juan de Aznalfarache (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue at the upper hoist and yellow at the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Juan de Aznalfarache (a castle on blue, a Maltese cross on red, a wheel and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of San Juan de Aznalfarache; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: San Juan de Aznalfarache arms — castle on blue, Maltese cross on red, wheel and tree
